item.title: Manchester City Launch Bid for Crystal Palace Captain Marc Guehi
item.description: Manchester City have made a move to sign Crystal Palace captain Marc Guehi, with talks reportedly underway to agree on terms with the England defender. City have also opened discussions with Palace over a transfer fee for the 25-year-old.Crystal Palace are reportedly asking for around £40 million for their skipper, who has just six months remaining on his current contract.
